title: Overlooked players: Banti and the Viper
summary: He recalls a trombonist named Banti and a trumpeter called the Viper who played with the valve buttons removed.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Of course, the band changed personnel. At different periods, they had different guys come in. It changed. And I'd like to mention a couple of guys who were spectacular. You know, so many people got overlooked during that period, you know.
We had a trombone player who came in. His name was Banti. That's all I ever knew, was Banti. [SPELLS] But a fantastic player. Good lead, just like Doc, but you'd play
or somebody else would play, and he's got it, just like a continuum, you know.

And there was another trumpet player, ...[INAUDIBLE NAME]... It was the first time I saw a guy playing without the buttons on. He had taken the buttons off the keys, you know. And they called him the Viper. And he was some trumpet player, a very spectacular trumpet player.
